description: Recurring suggestions: the normalised title key of each title, and for each ledger and day, the suggestions Penny offers (src/domain/suggestions.ts and RecurringSuggestions.swift give the same).

cases.name: monthly expense after a price step that held: the newest amount, was the old one
anchor day 31 keeps the last day in shorter months
yearly on a leap day: two entries, the anchor stays the 29th
a skipped month among six: 80% of the gaps still fit
a skipped month among four: too few gaps fit
near-duplicate titles group together; the most common category wins
entries a schedule recorded are left out
a group an existing schedule covers is left out
a dismissed suggestion stays hidden while its amount holds
a dismissed suggestion comes back when its amount moves more than 25%
groceries with uneven amounts are not suggested
a price step that didn't hold yet is not suggested
stale: the latest entry is more than 1.5 intervals ago
two monthly entries are too few
entries after today are left out, and the next date follows today
small changes within $2 or 10% are steady: the newest amount, no was
the same title as an expense and as income are separate groups
